structured.rankingRationale: OENOVITI and GDPM rank highest because they are in Nyon with exact dates and concrete accommodation signals. SVGW follows for its two-day Morges programme and dinner. NADA, FER and UNIGE are credible but have venue/date or geography constraints. CCIFS is useful day-meeting/F&B and series-capture intelligence. AICC has a confirmed incumbent and is monitor-only.
notesForDeepResearch: Prioritize OENOVITI and GDPM accommodation/PCO follow-up, then SVGW lodging process.
For Geneva training, pursue day-meeting/F&B or future sessions rather than assume room blocks.
Do not present AICC as available current-edition hotel demand.
materialUncertainties: No attendance or peak-room figures are published.
No candidate is treated as open inventory without explicit sourcing evidence.
Confirmed venues are competitive intelligence, overflow or future-capture signals.
NADA publishes August 2027 but not exact dates.
